hooks.command: bash -c 'file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"file_path\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [[ "$file" =~ Domain\.(ts|java|py)$ ]] || [[ "$file" =~ /domain/ ]]; then if grep -qE "import.*(aws-sdk|@aws-sdk|dynamodb|express|fastify|axios|pg|mysql|redis|mongoose|typeorm|hibernate|spring|django|flask)" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then echo "DOMAIN PURITY VIOLATION: Infrastructure import detected in domain file: $file"; echo "Move infrastructure concerns to an adapter in adapter/outbound/."; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: enforce-domain-purity: Block infrastructure imports in domain files. Rejects writes to *Domain.{ts,java,py} files containing framework or infrastructure library imports.

hooks.command: bash -c 'file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"file_path\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [[ "$file" =~ Adapter\.(ts|java|py)$ ]]; then count=$(grep -cE "implements\s+\w+" "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$count" -gt 1 ]; then echo "PORT CONTRACT WARNING: Adapter $file implements $count port(s). Each adapter should implement exactly one port interface."; exit 1; fi; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: validate-port-contracts: Warn if an adapter file implements more than one port interface. Matched files: **/*Adapter.{ts,java,py}.

hooks.command: bash -c 'file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"file_path\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [[ "$file" =~ \.(ts|java|py)$ ]] && [[ ! "$file" =~ /routing/ ]]; then if grep -qE "cell-[0-9]+\.(invoke|send|get|put|query)|CELL_[A-Z0-9_]+_ENDPOINT" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then echo "CROSS-CELL VIOLATION: Direct cross-cell call detected in $file."; echo "Use the routing layer or publish a domain event on the cell EventBridge bus."; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: block-cross-cell-calls: Reject direct cross-cell method calls not going through the routing layer. Matched files: **/cells/**/*.{ts,java,py} (excluding routing/).

hooks.command: bash -c 'file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"file_path\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [[ "$file" =~ Adapter\.(ts|java|py)$ ]]; then if grep -qE "(password|secret|api_key|apiKey|token)\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"]" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then echo "SECURITY HIGH: Hardcoded credential in outbound adapter $file. Use environment variables or AWS Secrets Manager."; echo "Flagging for @security-agent review."; exit 1; fi; if grep -qE "eval\(|exec\(|execSync\(|child_process" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then echo "SECURITY CRITICAL: Dynamic code execution in $file. Injection risk. Flag for @security-agent review."; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: adapter-security-scan: Grep for injection patterns and hardcoded credentials in adapter files. Flags SecurityAgent for review on HIGH/CRITICAL findings.

hooks.command: bash -c 'file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"file_path\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [[ "$file" =~ /ports/ ]] && [[ "$file" =~ \.(ts|java|py)$ ]]; then echo "PORT CONTRACT CHANGE DETECTED in $file."; echo "Run /project:generate-adr to document this change and migration path before the change is reviewed."; echo "ADR is mandatory for any port interface modification."; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: adr-on-boundary-change: Print reminder to invoke /generate-adr when a port interface file is modified. Matched files: **/ports/**/*.{ts,java,py}.
